# Goal
Kama round 12 ONLY. L1 holds planner seat. One claim C1 CALIBRATION (lowest assigned axis 7 vs operability 8): exact-source frozen evidence correspondence, old auxiliary snapshot mismatches 1 -> 0 in a new corrective snapshot; expose source correspondence separately from digest integrity, with fail-capable CLI and frozen controls. No scalar increase, capability acquisition, serving readiness or live host claim. Address routed D1-D5 in corpus/lessons/round-11-verifier-spotcheck.md. All work is lane-local historical-evidence repair.
# Contract
Root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin. Tools start in fleet root: EVERY tool path MUST be absolute beneath /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin. Leaf only; no delegation, no background jobs, no commits, no builds/tests/linters/formatters/smoke runs. Main L1 runs verification once after integration. Read only necessary files; do not edit immutable prior round evidence except appending explicit historical disclaimers/corrections. Never edit verifier files, MANIFEST, fleet repo, host/config/env/services, routing, existing tools/ or registry/. No endpoint calls. Each seat may write its unique report /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-12/advice/<NAME>.md, explicitly requested documentation. Report actual static findings, unrun != pass. All seats are author advisors, not independent closure. Tooling authorization: you may install or upgrade helpful tools after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in result); do not install unnecessary tools.
# Shared interfaces
Fidelity implementation owner writes ONLY /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-12/fidelity.py, /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-12/frozen/**. CLI python3 /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-12/fidelity.py --snapshot PATH [--manifest PATH] [--repo PATH] [--selftest]. Default manifest /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-12/frozen/expected.json. Source commit fixed 2f7303c242319c1dc96c6bcf7702ac18b3ca1aad, source_path corpus/SOURCES.md. New snapshot /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-12/frozen/corpus/SOURCES.md produced directly from git show bytes, never tool-rendered text. Manifest pins snapshot SHA-256, source commit/path and expected clean verdict. Read-only git show compares immutable blob with snapshot; findings source_mismatch (exit1), snapshot_tampered (exit2), source_unavailable (exit2), clean(exit0). Snapshot override without manifest allows observing old mismatch rather than tamper. Isolated --selftest invokes actual CLI for clean/mismatch/tamper/unavailable; no live writes. Runner owner writes ONLY /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-12/reproduce.py; calls fidelity CLI on old round11 frozen SOURCES with no manifest, new snapshot with default manifest, selftest, and isolated source+manifest coherent-mutation attack, capturing full commands/stdout/stderr/exit. Do not run it.
